exercises.instruction: Read the situations in the scene and write a new sentence with the same meaning, using unless.
exercises.scene:
The situations (read the descriptions):
1. You must try a bit harder, or you won’t pass the exam.
2. Listen carefully, or you won’t know what to do.
3. She must apologise to you, or you’ll never speak to her again.
4. You have to speak very slowly, or he won’t understand you.
5. Business must improve soon, or the company will have to close.
6. You need to do something soon, or the problem will get worse.

answers: You won't pass the exam unless you try a bit harder.
You won't know what to do unless you listen carefully.
I'll never speak to her again unless she apologises (to me).
Unless she apologises (to me), I'll never speak to her again.
He won't understand you unless you speak very slowly.
Unless you speak very slowly, he won't understand you.
The company will have to close unless business improves soon.
Unless business improves soon, the company will have to close.
The problem will get worse unless we do something soon.
Unless we do something soon, the problem will get worse.

exercises.instruction: Read the situations in the scene and write sentences with unless.
exercises.scene:
The situations (read the descriptions):
1. The club isn’t open to everyone. You are allowed in only if you are a member.
2. You don’t want to go to the party alone. You are going only if your friend goes too.
3. You are not worried about the dog. It will chase you only if you move suddenly.
4. Ben isn’t very talkative. He will speak to you only if you ask him something.
5. Today is a public holiday. The doctor will see you only if it is an emergency.

answers: You aren't allowed in the club unless you're a member.
I'm not going (to the party) unless you go too.
I'm not going (to the party) unless you're going too.
The dog won't chase you unless you move suddenly.
Ben won't speak to you unless you ask him something.
The doctor won't see you unless it's an emergency.
The doctor won't see you unless it's an emergency.

exercises.instruction: Read the descriptions and choose unless, as long as or provided.

items.cue: 🚗 You can borrow my car ________ you promise not to drive too fast.
🏖️ We’re going to the beach tomorrow ________ the weather is bad.
🏖️ We’re going to the beach tomorrow ________ the weather is good.
🌙 I don’t mind if you come home late ________ you come in quietly.
🚪 I’m going now ________ you want me to stay.
📺 I don’t watch TV ________ I have nothing else to do.
🏊 Children are allowed to use the swimming pool ________ they are with an adult.
🏊 ________ they are with an adult, children are not allowed to use the swimming pool.
🪟 We can sit here in the corner ________ you’d rather sit by the window.
💰 A: Our holiday cost a lot of money. B: Did it? Well, that doesn’t matter ________ you enjoyed yourselves.

exercises.instruction: Use your own ideas to complete the sentences.

modelAnswers: We'll be late unless we take a taxi.
